#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
M2-0 验收条件验证脚本
场景：表单提交 → 结构化数据输出
验证：硬断言检查数据格式、字段完整性、CSV 文件生成
"""
import csv
import os
from datetime import datetime

# 输出目录
OUTPUT_DIR = "data/output"
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# 模拟表单提交数据
form_data = {
    "name": "测试用户",
    "email": "test@example.com",
    "product": "Sapiens AI Pro",
    "quantity": 3,
    "price": 299.00,
    "total": 897.00,
    "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
}

# 生成 CSV 文件
csv_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "form_result.csv")
fieldnames = ["name", "email", "product", "quantity", "price", "total", "timestamp"]

with open(csv_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerow(form_data)

# 硬断言验证
assert os.path.exists(csv_path), f"CSV 文件未生成: {csv_path}"

with open(csv_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    rows = list(reader)

assert len(rows) > 0, "CSV 文件为空"
assert set(fieldnames) == set(rows[0].keys()), f"字段不匹配: {rows[0].keys()}"
assert rows[0]["name"] == "测试用户", f"name 字段错误: {rows[0]['name']}"
assert rows[0]["email"] == "test@example.com", f"email 字段错误: {rows[0]['email']}"
assert float(rows[0]["total"]) == 897.00, f"total 字段错误: {rows[0]['total']}"
assert "T" in rows[0]["timestamp"], f"timestamp 格式错误: {rows[0]['timestamp']}"

print("✓ 所有硬断言通过")
print(f"✓ CSV 文件已生成: {csv_path}")
print(f"✓ 数据行数: {len(rows)}")
print(f"✓ 字段列表: {fieldnames}")
